verdict.rationale: The evidence does not publish any expected timelines: no stated preparation time from Plymouth Street and no government (USCIS) processing times. The only related material is a marketing claim of a "predictable timeline" and a mention of SLAs for employer multi-case workflows. Neither states actual durations, so the applicable axis is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a founder, expected timelines are published — the provider's own preparation time and the government processing times it depends on
